Author: SunnysOfficial
Name: Venue Mapper
Description: A Dalamud plugin for discovering FFXIV venues with 2D/3D interactive markers, live events, and built-in owner tools. Your complete FFXIV venue guide.
Changelog:
## v0.5.9

- Added: New Warning notification style for real failures like a failed teleport or config pull
- Added: Notification History window - a running log of recent notifications, opened via the new bell icon in the title bar
- Added: Hovering a notification pauses its countdown
- Added: Countdown bar on each notification showing time left
- Added: Changing the notification position in Settings shows an instant confirmation
- Improved: Notification cards restyled with an accent bar, pop-in animation, and pulse for Warning/Easter Egg
- Added: New quick popup that can appear when you enter a venue, showing status at a glance with quick toggles for 3D Markers, Strong Pulse and Marker Color Override
- Added: Copy Address and Directory buttons in the quick popup
- Added: "Show quick popup on venue enter" setting
- Added: "/vmapper quick" command to open or close the quick popup manually
- Added: New Venue Details window with avatar, Visit/Copy Lifestream Command buttons, and a Next Event card
- Added: Crown filter in the Directory to show only venues you own
- Added: Separate auto-open setting for your own venue
- Added: Send Feedback button in the About tab
- Improved: Directory and Events cards have properly rounded corners and a cleaner accent-bar highlight
- Improved: Navigation tabs simplified and more stable
- Improved: Scrollbars consistently styled everywhere
- Improved: Right-click context menu styling cleaned up
- Improved: About tab support buttons reorganized into a 2x2 grid
- Improved: Event schedule lookups now use a single efficient bulk request
- Fixed: Copy Lifestream now copies the correct teleport command
- Fixed: Marker color override wasn't applied to the marker's background
- Fixed: Hardened several windows against a rare crash and UI-rendering-corruption issue
- Fixed: Main window could lose its saved position under certain conditions
- Fixed: Some venues' open/closed status could be wrong with more than one weekly schedule entry
- Fixed: A venue's Partake logo could be wrong or missing if it currently has no listed events
- Improved: Venue schedule data now survives a plugin reload or game restart
- Improved: Several Settings labels shortened, auto-open/quick-popup toggles now in a fixed two-column grid
- Fixed: A failed venue schedule fetch (e.g. a rate limit) could retry instantly in a tight loop instead of waiting for the normal cooldown
- Added: "Hide 3D markers in my venue" setting next to 3D World Markers - visible to everyone, but only enabled with a registered Owner ID
- Changed: The "Own venue" auto-open setting is now always visible in Settings (greyed out without a registered Owner ID) instead of being hidden entirely
- Added: A short "What's New" popup for major updates like this one, summarizing new features and settings without repeating the entire setup wizard
- Fixed: A venue's FFXIVVenues banner and open/closed schedule status could fail to load if its FFXIVVenues link used the alternate hash-style URL format instead of the standard /venue/ path format
